column4: command: graph check debug walk from root and from the origin; reports Towntopia's own map
route price of a tile list; only caller is testkit/TestCommands; rules null = villager costs, so it agrees with search
the route search step cost (rules cost multipliers, link cost)
the route search step test (searchStep: never tiles, link steps, raiders skip links); a link step's rise fails the original test
the smoothing shortcut (smoothPath=true): a straight leg must not cross a never tile the traced route went around
marks every step into a blocked route tile failed for 10 min; with the bridge a link into that tile is marked too (its far stop is blocked)
cut kind 1 (furniture or block shapes) marks the cut step failed only if it is a step; must agree with the search's view
join phase: walks off-route onto the first tile (arrives within 0.35 blocks, stuck after 60 ticks without progress); short, and a faster pace risks overshooting that tile
the walk along the route line: road speed applies here (this.speed itself, the run/jump/climb threshold, stays)

reachability pieces (TileAdapter.kind): cells.reaches, NavReachability.canReach, island removal in local updates; every answer goes through NavBridge.cellKind: a never tile is kind 2 (kept by the island flood, blocked for access and reaches), not -1 (island removal would delete it) nor 1 (the access flood follows 1); a link region is an island without it
reachability adapter: Towntopia's own step test stays (a never step here would be -1 and cut the tile out as an island); never rules apply through this method's CELL rows
far-stop seeding: a polled link start creates its far node and the link edge; runs for full builds, sliced builds and local updates
stuck recovery: does this tile have a usable way out (also its no-root reachability fallback)
stuck log line counting usable exits; rewritten so it reports the map as the search sees it
stuck recovery local BFS (6 xz, 4 y) for a safe tile to place the villager on; a short link inside that box counts as a step
stuck spy line (step ok / no step ahead); rewritten so it reports the map as the search sees it
building access: is there a step between two tiles (entrance checks)
building access: can any routable neighbour step onto this tile (a never tile is unusable)
debug: stuck report text; shows Towntopia's own step verdicts
traveler gathering spots: BFS of reachable tiles outside a door
